theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 := by
  by_cases h : n % 2 = 0
  · exact_mod_cast (Nat.mul_add _ _).symm
  · have h1 : n % 2 = 1 := Eq.trans h (Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h).mp
    have h2 : (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = 0 :=
      calc
        (n ^ 2 + n) % 2 = ((n ^ 2 % 2 + n % 2) % 2) : by rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_add]
        ... = ((1 + 1) % 2) : by rw [Nat.pow_mod, Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h1, Nat.mod_eq_iff_div_eq h1]
        ... = 0 : by rw [Nat.add_right_inj, Nat.add_self_eq_twice, Nat.two_mul]
    exact h2
